skill_name: Generate a new recipe for chicken Parmesan.
workflow: This simple yet delicious chicken Parmesan recipe is sure to delight your family. Start by seasoning 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts with salt and pepper. then dip them in beaten egg and coat with Panko crumbs. Next, heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken on each side for 4 to 5 minutes until fully cooked.
